reproduction.rationale: Matched assistance is declared in access-conditions.v1.json, but authentic common/code manifests, evaluation identity, runtime/exposure and finite budgets are not yet frozen. Authenticate all19 participant/window identities, behavioral awake/LOR labels and responsiveness times; preserve stable-state/deep-LOR boundary exclusions and complete source evaluation support. Bind original paired GSR/noGSR450-ROI inputs and18 feature preparation, 4-minute windows stepping oneTR, network identities and source non-overlapping sampling semantics. Recover original20,000-per-class training sampling and random forest recipe or a documented original-protocol rerun with fixed provenance, paired candidate/author draws and justified published-result calibration. Recover precision of0.93 balanced accuracy and0.984 AUC plus original ROC-curve aggregation, source controls and native classifier replay. The existing scorer subject-macro AUC does not prove parity with the displayed source curve. Predeclare numerical reproduction and same-paper superiority criteria above the actual published target and calibrated reference, with meaningful effect and paired participant uncertainty accounting for overlapping LOSO fits; freeze source assistance and finite resource/search budgets.
